usedFor: Roadmap changes in ProductPlan, like “Roadmap Bar Is Updated”, tag or move contacts in LeadConnector.

bestTemplate.name: “Roadmap Bar Is Updated” in ProductPlan, then “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A changed roadmap bar tags a contact LeadConnector finds by email or phone, so the right people get the update.

watchOut: ProductPlan triggers here are polling, and a roadmap event names no contact, so pass an email or phone to LeadConnector.
